messages.subject: [unmarked] Multi scale occupancy estimation function
parts:
Hi is there any interest in writing a function for a multi-scale
occupancy model a variation of Pollock’s robust design in your
unmarked package. The model is described in a paper by Nichols et al
2008, “Multi-scale occupancy estimation and modeling using multiple
detection methods”, Journal of Applied Ecology. I would like to use
this model with point transects and use the removal method on our
minute intervals to estimate occupancy. Has anyone else though of
this approach?

Rob
